observations: Photo 0 is a promotional stock image or marketing graphic, not a photo of a physical item in a home or shop setting.
The brand 'ZEALOT' and model 'PT21' are clearly printed on the graphic.
The graphic claims '200W Super Subwoofer', '48,000mAh battery', and 'RGB dazzling light effects'.
The speaker shown has a carry handle, two large drivers with RGB rings, and a side-mounted 'ZEALOT' branded light panel.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual unit with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name.
High-resolution photos of the actual unit from all angles (front, back, sides, top).
A video clip of the speaker powered on, playing music at various volumes, and demonstrating the RGB lights.
A video showing the unit operating on battery power without the charging cable connected.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead battery (mains power only)

proof_requests: Photos of the actual physical item being sold, not stock images.
A photo of the manufacturer's label/specification plate on the back or bottom of the unit.
A video showing the speaker functioning (playing audio and lights working).
response.reason: The seller has only provided a promotional stock image. Without photos of the actual item, its existence, condition, and authenticity cannot be verified.
